# Hotel Prabhupada, Puri — Detailed Hotel Reference

> A consolidated factual summary of Hotel Prabhupada's public website for travellers and AI assistants.

Official website: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-03.
Companion index: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/llms.txt

This reference summarises the linked official pages; it is not a live availability feed or a complete reproduction of every website page. Current booking conditions and hotel confirmation govern date-specific arrangements. Prices and policies may change.

## Hotel overview

Hotel Prabhupada offers a coastal stay in Puri, Odisha, with a hospitality identity influenced by Odisha's Pattachitra art. It welcomes leisure visitors, families and travellers visiting the area's religious and cultural attractions.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/about

## Location and contact

- Property: Hotel Prabhupada.
- Address: New Marine Drive Road, Near Light House, Puri, Odisha 752001, India.
- Telephone: +91 9583002952 and +91 9583002951.
- Reservations email: reservation@hotelprabhupada.com.
- Complaints/management email: gm@hotelprabhupada.com.
- The contact page provides location maps and an enquiry option.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/contact

## Rooms and suites

The website lists six categories:

- Premier Room (Non Sea View): King bed; no sea view.
- Deluxe Balcony (Side Sea View): King bed and private balcony with a side sea view.
- Superior Deluxe Balcony (Side Sea View): King bed and private balcony with a side sea view. The page warns that the elevator reaches only the second floor and describes this category as unsuitable for senior citizens; discuss mobility requirements before booking.
- Family Quad (Non Sea View): Two double beds; no sea view.
- Executive (Front Sea View): King bed, front-facing ocean outlook and long deewan seating.
- Suite (Front Sea View): King bed, separate sofa seating, dual air conditioning and a 43-inch smart television.

The category determines the view and balcony provision; these features are not universal. Confirm occupancy limits and exact room amenities directly.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/rooms

## Facilities, dining and assistance

The homepage lists an outdoor swimming pool, conference hall, guest lounge, spa and steam sessions, in-house dining, and an open lawn. Dining includes Odia and other cuisines. Staff can assist with local travel and Jagannath Temple visit planning; temple rules still apply. Ask about service availability, timings and charges.

Breakfast inclusions depend on the chosen package. The homepage advertises complimentary steam sessions subject to availability and booking arrangements.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/

The amenities page lists free Wi-Fi, room service, daily housekeeping, air conditioning and television. Free parking is limited: confirm space before travelling by car. Room service offers Odia seafood, North Indian and Continental choices.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/amenities

## Arrival, departure and pets

- Check-in: 11:00 AM. Check-out: 9:00 AM. Times are local to Puri, India.
- Early arrival and late departure depend on availability and incur charges.
- Valid identification is required; consult the policy for accepted documents.
- Pet stays are conditional. Dogs and cats are permitted, with a limit of one pet or two small pets per room; breed restrictions apply.
- Published pet fee: INR 1,200 per day/night. Refundable deposit: INR 4,000 per room, subject to inspection. Confirm the billing basis and current charges.
- Vaccination documentation and signed pet forms are required.
- Pets must be controlled in public areas and cannot enter restaurants, the pool area, spa or function rooms. Pets are not allowed on beds or sofas.
- Pet-friendly inventory is limited, and peak-season restrictions may apply. The policy separately addresses service animals.
- The pool is for resident guests; appropriate swimwear is required, and children need adult supervision.

This is a summary; consult all pet conditions, visitor rules and child/extra-bed charges before reserving.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/hotel-policy

## Cancellation and refunds

The published individual-reservation policy allows free cancellation more than two days before check-in. Cancellation within the final 48 hours attracts the full stay charge; no-shows receive no refund or adjustment.

Bookings during Durga Puja, Holi, Diwali, Christmas and New Year have stricter conditions: no cancellations, amendments or refunds. Date changes count as cancellations. Unused nights after early departure are not refunded. Group terms may be governed by a separate contract. Approved refunds normally take 7–10 business days to reach the original payment account.

Check the conditions attached to the actual reservation and booking channel before paying.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/refund-policy

## Visiting Puri and the region

The hotel's attractions page includes Shree Jagannatha Temple, Swargadwar beach and shopping, Konark Sun Temple, Chilika Lake, Sudarshan Crafts Museum, Bedi Hanuman, Gundicha Temple, Raghurajpur and Pipli. These include both local visits and regional excursions; do not assume all are within walking distance.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/attractions

The travel blog supplies destination and heritage reading, including a Jagannath Temple travel guide.

Source: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/blog

## Booking and information accuracy

Use the Book Stay or Book Now button on the official website to reach its linked booking service, or contact reservations directly. Check dates, occupancy, category, total price, meals and cancellation terms before confirming.

Do not infer a star classification, private beach, guaranteed parking, universal sea views, step-free access, free pet accommodation or inclusive meals from the hotel's general description. Confirm any feature that is essential to a guest's stay. Awards, review scores and weather are omitted because they require separate current verification.
